description: Golden suite for the Northstar Financial policy assistant. Cases cover simple lookup, multi-hop policy, out-of-domain refusals, and entity grounding.

test_cases.query: How many PTO days do full-time employees receive each year?
reference_contexts: Northstar Financial Services provides 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year to full-time employees. Unused PTO may be carried over, up to a maximum of 5 days, into the following year.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of PTO per calendar year.

test_cases.query: How many unused PTO days can I carry into next year?
reference_contexts: Unused PTO may be carried over, up to a maximum of 5 days, into the following year. PTO blackout dates run from December 20 through December 31.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following year.

test_cases.query: Are there any PTO blackout dates?
reference_contexts: PTO blackout dates run from December 20 through December 31. PTO requests of 5 or more consecutive days require manager approval at least 14 days in advance.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes. PTO blackout dates run from December 20 through December 31.

test_cases.query: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit while traveling?
reference_contexts: Meal expenses are reimbursed up to $75 per day while traveling. Itemized receipts are required for any expense greater than $25. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Meal expenses are reimbursed up to $75 per day while traveling.

test_cases.query: When do I need a receipt for an expense?
reference_contexts: Itemized receipts are required for any expense greater than $25. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Itemized receipts are required for any expense greater than $25.

test_cases.query: How fast must a P1 security incident be acknowledged?
reference_contexts: Priority 1 (P1) incidents require acknowledgment within 15 minutes and a status update every 30 minutes until containment. Priority 2 (P2) incidents require acknowledgment within 1 hour.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: P1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

test_cases.query: How many days per week am I expected in the office?
reference_contexts: Employees are expected on-site at least 3 days per week. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Employees are expected on-site at least 3 days per week.

reference_contexts: Northstar matches 100% of employee 401(k) contributions up to 6% of eligible compensation. Matching contributions vest on a 3-year graded schedule.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Northstar matches 100% of employee 401(k) contributions up to 6% of eligible compensation.

test_cases.query: Do vendors that process customer data need SOC 2?
reference_contexts: All vendors that process customer data must provide a current SOC 2 Type II report. Vendors without SOC 2 may be accepted only with a compensating controls memo signed by the CISO.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes. Vendors that process customer data must provide a current SOC 2 Type II report, unless a CISO-signed compensating controls memo is approved.

test_cases.query: How long are customer account records kept after an account is closed?
reference_contexts: Customer account records are retained for 7 years after account closure. Chat transcripts with the internal assistant are retained for 90 days.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Customer account records are retained for 7 years after account closure.

test_cases.query: Can I paste a customer's Social Security number into a public chatbot to summarize a case?
reference_contexts: Restricted data includes Social Security numbers, account numbers, and authentication secrets. Restricted data must not be pasted into public large language models.
Public consumer chatbots are not approved for work product containing customer data.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: No. Social Security numbers are Restricted data and must not be pasted into public large language models or consumer chatbots.

test_cases.query: I want two full weeks of PTO in March. What approval timing applies?
reference_contexts: Northstar Financial Services provides 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year to full-time employees.
PTO requests of 5 or more consecutive days require manager approval at least 14 days in advance.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Two weeks is 10 consecutive days, so manager approval is required at least 14 days in advance.

test_cases.query: If a P1 outage is confirmed to impact customers, who else must be notified and how soon?
reference_contexts: Priority 1 (P1) incidents require acknowledgment within 15 minutes and a status update every 30 minutes until containment.
Customer-impacting outages must be reported to Legal within 2 hours of confirmation.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Legal must be notified within 2 hours of confirmation of a customer-impacting outage.

test_cases.query: What will Northstar's stock price be next quarter?
reference_contexts: Northstar classifies information into four tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted.
Public consumer chatbots are not approved for work product containing customer data.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: I don't know. The internal policy knowledge base does not contain stock price forecasts.

test_cases.query: Summarize Apex Capital's Q2 earnings and compare their 401(k) match to ours.
reference_contexts: Northstar matches 100% of employee 401(k) contributions up to 6% of eligible compensation.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: I can report Northstar's 401(k) match (100% up to 6%), but Apex Capital earnings are not in this knowledge base so I cannot summarize them.

test_cases.query: What stipend does a primary on-call engineer receive?
reference_contexts: Primary on-call engineers receive a $150 stipend per week. Secondary on-call receives $50 per week.
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Primary on-call engineers receive a $150 stipend per week.
